fixes.explanation: Not quite, baker, and I'd say that was a sneaky one. Jesus does say it, in His own words: a colt "…on which no one has ever sat." (Mark 11:2) So the statement is true. Jesus knows this colt well enough to tell the two disciples exactly where to find it and how to get it, and that's a lot of detail to hand out before the colt has even been untied.
